ramps.name: Viridis

ramps.name: Walnut

ramps.name: Water

document.name: Agate
document.description: Irregular compressed growth bands around an eccentric centre, with fine mineral grain.

guide.hint: Inspect the circular bands before turbulence; orbit the cutaway to follow the same bands through the stone.

document.name: Analytic crosswave volume
document.description: A clamped radial field interpolates two oblique sine/cosine waves through depth; inspect XZ and YZ slices.

guide.hint: A clamped radial field interpolates two oblique sine/cosine waves through depth; inspect XZ and YZ slices.

document.name: Asphalt
document.description: Dominant near-black binder, fine rough grain and sparse tiny brighter stone flecks.

document.name: Aurora
document.description: Several green-blue-violet curtains with fine vertical filaments and dark space between their folds.

guide.hint: Inspect curtain bands and filament detail separately; use the slice for the clearest sky view.

document.name: Autumn leaf litter
document.description: Rust, ochre and gold patches over dark gaps suggest a dense forest-floor carpet.

document.name: Bamboo nodes and grain
document.description: Periodic crosswise node bands interrupt long green axial grain and broad internode variation.

guide.hint: Periodic crosswise node bands interrupt long green axial grain and broad internode variation.

document.name: Fissured bark
document.description: Broken longitudinal fissures separate broad brown bark plates beneath finer woody streaks.

document.name: Bayer ordered coverage
document.description: A repeated 4-by-4 Bayer threshold matrix compares local ordered values with a broad coverage gradient.

guide.hint: A repeated 4-by-4 Bayer threshold matrix compares local ordered values with a broad coverage gradient.

document.name: Bent ribbons
document.description: Horizontal-position-dependent bending curves a regular ribbon field into a fan of arcs.

guide.hint: Set bend amount to zero for straight ribbons; vary it to reveal horizontal-position-dependent curvature.

document.name: Birch bark
document.description: Short horizontal dark scars and faint grey-green mottling on quiet pale bark.

guide.hint: Change the horizontal scar scale independently of the pale mottled substrate.

document.name: Darken — ink inclusions
document.description: Darken blending selects the darker source or backdrop channel, placing muted cell-shaped pigment over ridged mineral noise.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Difference — chromatic fossils
document.description: Channel differences between seeded cell pigment and ridged noise produce dark red and blue negative-like fragments.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Exclusion — muted negatives
document.description: Exclusion blending creates subdued negative-like colours from seeded cell pigment and ridged mineral noise.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Lighten — pearl inclusions
document.description: Lighten blending selects the brighter source or backdrop channel, leaving pale cell-shaped inclusions in ridged mineral noise.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Multiply — mineral overprint
document.description: Seeded cell pigment darkens a ridged mineral backdrop while preserving its internal structure through multiply blending.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Normal — cell pigment
document.description: Partly opaque seeded cell pigment covers ridged mineral noise with ordinary source-over blending.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Overlay — patinated stone
document.description: Overlay blending increases light and dark contrast where seeded cell pigment meets ridged mineral noise.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Screen — luminous pigment
document.description: Screen blending lightens a ridged mineral backdrop with seeded cell pigment, producing pale luminous-looking regions.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Soft light — glazed stone
document.description: Seeded cell pigment gently modulates the contrast of a ridged mineral backdrop through soft-light blending.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; vary opacity while keeping the same inputs to compare the nine blend modes.

document.name: Box distance bands
document.description: Signed-distance colours form rounded rectangular bands inside and outside a box.

guide.hint: Inspect signed distance in greyscale; zero is the primitive boundary, negative values are inside, and positive values are outside.

document.name: Gilded branching ink
document.description: A finite seeded binary network tapers from a trunk into fine dendritic branches; its signed tube envelope maps directly to gold and blue.

guide.hint: A finite seeded binary network tapers from a trunk into fine dendritic branches; its signed tube envelope maps directly to gold and blue.

document.name: Branching leaf veins
document.description: A bounded branching field supplies tapering vein colour inside a simple elliptical leaf mask; coordinates remain an extruded XY texture.

guide.hint: A bounded branching field supplies tapering vein colour inside a simple elliptical leaf mask; coordinates remain an extruded XY texture.

document.name: Branching root volume
document.description: A finite 3D branching network descends as roots in a dark matrix. A centred repeat places the branching interior across depth seams for visible slices and cutaways.

guide.hint: A finite 3D branching network descends as roots in a dark matrix. A centred repeat places the branching interior across depth seams for visible slices and cutaways.

document.name: Brecciated marble
document.description: True 3D Voronoi edge distance separates fragments of old-style Perlin marble with dark mineral grout. All slice axes reveal a different section.

guide.hint: Inspect the cell-edge threshold; move through Z to see different fragments rather than extruded tiles.

document.name: Brushed gold
document.description: Fine horizontal brushing beneath broad gold-toned highlight bands.

document.name: Brushed steel
document.description: Dense fine horizontal scratches under broad cool silver-toned highlight bands.

document.name: Mirrored mineral veins
document.description: A bilateral domain fold mirrors intricate blue and gold noise veins around the centre.

document.name: Camouflage
document.description: Unequal large olive and tan field shapes engulfing smaller brown and black secondary patches.

document.name: Candy-cane stripes
document.description: Clean red and warm-white diagonal bands with a narrow softened edge.

document.name: Capped-cylinder bands
document.description: Signed-distance contours extend inside and outside a finite capped cylinder; different slice planes reveal its sides and caps.

guide.hint: Inspect signed distance in greyscale; zero is the primitive boundary, negative values are inside, and positive values are outside.

document.name: Caustics
document.description: Thin caustic-like sunlight ridges, weaker secondary lines and calm blue pool water.

guide.hint: Compare with Ocean and pond ripples to separate branching highlights from directional and circular water patterns.

document.name: Cell-identity warp
document.description: Nearest-cell lattice coordinates drive discrete jumps in a Perlin field, producing faceted grey distortions.

guide.hint: Inspect the cell-ID vector before displacement; it preserves nearest-site lattice coordinates rather than random RGB.

document.name: True cell-edge distance
document.description: The same 2D Euclidean sites and narrow edge ramp; actual distance to the nearest bisector produces consistent-width borders.

guide.hint: The sites, scale and ramp are identical. True edge distance measures distance to a bisector; the gap is a difference of distances to two sites.

document.name: Neighbour-gap edges
document.description: The same 2D Euclidean sites and narrow edge ramp; F2−F1 only approximates edge distance, so border widths vary.

guide.hint: The sites, scale and ramp are identical. True edge distance measures distance to a bisector; the gap is a difference of distances to two sites.

document.name: Regular cell grid
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB at scale 0.16: 2D cells, jitter 0, seed 42. Compare one changed parameter with Jittered cells.

guide.hint: Jittered cells is the baseline. Grid changes jitter only; reseeded changes seed only; volumetric changes dimensions only. 2D cells ignore Z; 3D cells change with depth.

document.name: Jittered cells
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB at scale 0.16: 2D cells, jitter 1, seed 42. Compare one changed parameter with Jittered cells.

guide.hint: Jittered cells is the baseline. Grid changes jitter only; reseeded changes seed only; volumetric changes dimensions only. 2D cells ignore Z; 3D cells change with depth.

document.name: Reseeded cells
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB at scale 0.16: 2D cells, jitter 1, seed 7. Compare one changed parameter with Jittered cells.

guide.hint: Jittered cells is the baseline. Grid changes jitter only; reseeded changes seed only; volumetric changes dimensions only. 2D cells ignore Z; 3D cells change with depth.

document.name: Volumetric cells
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB at scale 0.16: 3D cells, jitter 1, seed 42. Compare one changed parameter with Jittered cells.

guide.hint: Jittered cells is the baseline. Grid changes jitter only; reseeded changes seed only; volumetric changes dimensions only. 2D cells ignore Z; 3D cells change with depth.

document.name: Cellular frost
document.description: Fractal octaves of Worley F1 combine coarse crystalline lobes with fine frost. Demonstrates new noise inside the existing generic fractal.

guide.hint: Inspect the single Worley source before the fractal octaves; compare with nested Perlin-based frost.

document.name: Cellular pumice volume
document.description: Variable dark pore interiors occupy a three-dimensional pale matrix; cutaways expose the pore distribution as colour.

guide.hint: Variable dark pore interiors occupy a three-dimensional pale matrix; cutaways expose the pore distribution as colour.

document.name: Cellular reliquary
document.description: A smoothed box/torus difference masks old ridged stone with seeded cellular inlay; SDF contours highlight the carving.

guide.hint: Use the central XZ slice or cutaway to expose the inlay; inspect the smooth subtraction mask separately.

document.name: Cellular web
document.description: F2 minus F1 highlights a web where first and second feature-point distances coincide; this differs from actual edge distance.

guide.hint: Switch Worley Output between F1, F2 and gap; compare gap with true Voronoi cell-edge distance.

document.name: Checkerboard
document.description: An 8 by 8 checkerboard in XY, with one alternating layer per unit in depth.

guide.hint: Change depth from 1 to 8 and move the slice through Z to turn the planar checker into an 8×8×8 arrangement.

document.name: Higher-feed chemical colony
document.description: The Chemical colony recipe with feed raised from 0.035 to 0.04; grid, iterations, kill, diffusion, seed and colour mapping remain fixed.

guide.hint: Compare with Chemical colony (feed 0.035). One changed reaction parameter reorganises the membrane structure.

document.name: Initial chemical noise
document.description: The Chemical colony simulation after 0 steps; same grid, seed, feed, kill, diffusion and V colour mapping.

guide.hint: Compare 0, 100 and 550 steps. Only iteration count changes; these are cached static volumes rather than animated frames.

document.name: Developing chemical membranes
document.description: The Chemical colony simulation after 100 steps; same grid, seed, feed, kill, diffusion and V colour mapping.

guide.hint: Compare 0, 100 and 550 steps. Only iteration count changes; these are cached static volumes rather than animated frames.

document.name: Raw chemical U
document.description: Unremapped U concentration from the same periodic 48³, 550-step Gray–Scott volume, using a shared 0–1 greyscale ramp.

guide.hint: Compare raw U and V with identical simulation and palette. They are two coupled concentrations, not an assumed exact inverse.

document.name: Raw chemical V
document.description: Unremapped V concentration from the same periodic 48³, 550-step Gray–Scott volume, using a shared 0–1 greyscale ramp.

guide.hint: Compare raw U and V with identical simulation and palette. They are two coupled concentrations, not an assumed exact inverse.

document.name: Chipped multicoat paint
document.description: Nested thresholds of one wear field reveal teal paint, an ochre earlier coat and the dark substrate in correlated chips.

guide.hint: Nested thresholds of one wear field reveal teal paint, an ochre earlier coat and the dark substrate in correlated chips.

document.name: Cirrus clouds
document.description: Thin wind-stretched cloud streaks across a blue sky.

document.name: Cloud silhouette — scalar union
document.description: Three overlapping lobes define a contiguous cloud silhouette independently of its soft noisy interior shading.

guide.hint: Inspect the max-combined silhouette mask and the independently capped brightness field; compare with Cumulus.

document.name: Clouds
document.description: Broad pale cloud masses with soft interior shading and irregular edges against blue sky.

document.name: Coastal highlands
document.description: A broad island elevation meets a narrow shoreline palette; fine ridged detail appears only above the upland threshold. The result is a colour field, not displaced terrain.

guide.hint: Inspect broad elevation plus the coastal falloff, then the gated ridge contribution. Lower the threshold to extend detail toward the shore.

document.name: Colour to transparent
document.description: Cyan fades smoothly to zero alpha along X; its hue remains cyan throughout the fade.

guide.hint: The transparent endpoint carries no visible colour. Premultiplied interpolation avoids a dark or muddy fringe.

document.name: Cross-combed marbled paper
document.description: Two orthogonal triangular comb displacements pull narrow coloured bands into interlocking scallops.

guide.hint: Two orthogonal triangular comb displacements pull narrow coloured bands into interlocking scallops.

document.name: Concrete
document.description: Neutral low-contrast mottled cement with fine grain and sparse small light and dark aggregate.

document.name: Coloured contour map
document.description: Coloured elevation zones with overlaid contours and a heavier line every fourth interval.

guide.hint: Inspect the contour ramp and its duplicated stops; change line width without changing broad elevation colours.

document.name: Coordinate lens
document.description: An analytic displacement built from position, a constant vector and a rotation bends gold ribbons inside a fading circular lens. No noise is needed.

guide.hint: Inspect Position and the constant offset separately; turn warp amount to zero for straight bands.

document.name: Crosscurrent filaments
document.description: Two independently sampled flows combine to distort fine gold bands into irregular filaments on navy.

guide.hint: Inspect each flow and their vector sum; change their independent sampling transforms before the warp.

document.name: Cumulus
document.description: An overlapping rounded cloud with pale bulges, soft blue-grey crevices and a common shaded underside.

guide.hint: Compare with Cloud silhouette — scalar union; the older layered recipe couples colour and transparency.

document.name: Curl flow filaments
document.description: Central curl of three offset periodic fields displaces fine RGB filaments into a swirling flow. A bounded periodic domain keeps sampling increments well resolved.

guide.hint: Central curl of three offset periodic fields displaces fine RGB filaments into a swirling flow. A bounded periodic domain keeps sampling increments well resolved.

document.name: Sparse Dalmatian spots
document.description: Seeded per-cell omission and variable spot radii leave large quiet areas between irregular black marks.

guide.hint: Seeded per-cell omission and variable spot radii leave large quiet areas between irregular black marks.

document.name: Two-over-one twill
document.description: A cyclic row-and-column crossing schedule forms diagonal ribs through two thread directions.

guide.hint: A cyclic row-and-column crossing schedule forms diagonal ribs through two thread directions.

document.name: Diagonal inlay
document.description: Gold-rimmed round medallions repeat on a diagonal grid, extruded through the solid.

guide.hint: Swap the ordered domain children to compare translate→rotate with rotate→translate; Z projection retains visibility through the solid.

document.name: Quantised digital camouflage
document.description: Coordinates are snapped to a small grid before multiscale pigment fields are sampled, producing genuinely block-shaped boundaries.

guide.hint: Coordinates are snapped to a small grid before multiscale pigment fields are sampled, producing genuinely block-shaped boundaries.

document.name: Distance-faded ridges
document.description: Connected ridged crests weaken toward the boundary under a centre-distance falloff.

guide.hint: Inspect the unattenuated ridge field and distance falloff before their multiplication.

document.name: Double-warp mineral swirl
document.description: Large folds and finer internal eddies intertwine in a blue and pale pink mineral field.

guide.hint: Adjust the outer and inner warp amounts independently to separate broad folds from fine eddies.

document.name: Desert dunes
document.description: A few sweeping dune crests, lit windward slopes and steep shaded lee faces under fine sand.

document.name: Embers
document.description: Dark charcoal with sparse red-orange flecks and isolated yellow-hot points.

document.name: Field-oriented hatching
document.description: A broad smooth noise field rotates fine sampling stripes around a fixed central pivot, producing colour-only directional hatching.

guide.hint: A broad smooth noise field rotates fine sampling stripes around a fixed central pivot, producing colour-only directional hatching.

document.name: Field-seeded chemical spiral
document.description: A scalar spiral mask seeds a 2D Gray–Scott simulation. Reaction and diffusion break its analytic stripes into grown membranes; the result extrudes through depth.

guide.hint: A scalar spiral mask seeds a 2D Gray–Scott simulation. Reaction and diffusion break its analytic stripes into grown membranes; the result extrudes through depth.

document.name: Fire
document.description: Separate rising flame tongues, hot yellow-white bases and red-orange edges with dark gaps.

document.name: Herringbone block outlines
document.description: Native periodic domino ownership forms perpendicular blocks with constant-width grout.

guide.hint: Native periodic domino ownership forms perpendicular blocks with constant-width grout.

document.name: Flat colour
document.description: One opaque cyan colour, unchanged by position or depth.

guide.hint: The complete texture is one Flat node. Change its alpha to see transparency on the solid.

document.name: Flowing grout
document.description: A Perlin vector warp bends true Voronoi boundary-distance bands into an irregular ceramic glaze.

guide.hint: Inspect true cell-edge distance before the colour ramp; turn the vector warp off to recover straight cell boundaries.

document.name: Fog / Mist
document.description: Low-contrast drifting mist with broad calm density changes and a second faint veil.

document.name: Billowy fractal
document.description: 5 octaves, persistence 0.5 and lacunarity 2; billowy shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Persistent fractal
document.description: 5 octaves, persistence 0.8 and lacunarity 2; smooth shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Ridged fractal
document.description: 5 octaves, persistence 0.5 and lacunarity 2; ridged shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Smooth fractal
document.description: 5 octaves, persistence 0.5 and lacunarity 2; smooth shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Widely spaced octaves
document.description: 5 octaves, persistence 0.5 and lacunarity 3; smooth shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Two-octave fractal
document.description: 2 octaves, persistence 0.5 and lacunarity 2; smooth shaping with the same noise scale and greyscale ramp as the family.

guide.hint: Smooth is the baseline. Change only style, octave count, persistence or lacunarity in the corresponding comparison; scale and palette are identical.

document.name: Gated alpine ridges
document.description: Broad elevation gates fine ridged detail: valleys stay quiet while the high slopes carry crags.

guide.hint: Inspect broad elevation, fine ridge detail and the threshold that confines crags to uplands.

document.name: Giraffe markings
document.description: Warm irregular cellular patches with gently bent cream channels: a stylised flat marking pattern, extruded through depth.

guide.hint: Matching cell-value and true-edge configurations give each patch its own brown while preserving cream borders. These are markings, not simulated fur.

document.name: Gradient direction study
document.description: RGB encodes the unit direction of a three-dimensional periodic scalar gradient. Zero gradients map to neutral grey; this is field inspection for texture-space displacement.

guide.hint: RGB encodes the unit direction of a three-dimensional periodic scalar gradient. Zero gradients map to neutral grey; this is field inspection for texture-space displacement.

document.name: Gradient-guided hatching
document.description: A normalised scalar gradient gives bounded displacement of fine hatching, gathering lines around the changing direction of a periodic fractal field.

guide.hint: A normalised scalar gradient gives bounded displacement of fine hatching, gathering lines around the changing direction of a periodic fractal field.

document.name: Linear gradient
document.description: A clamped linear ramp from red to blue, with even OKLab colour interpolation.

guide.hint: Change ramp stops and mode; values beyond the endpoints clamp to the endpoint colours.

document.name: Granite
document.description: Fine pale crystalline matrix with fewer pink grains and sparse larger dark inclusions.

document.name: Greek key ornament
document.description: A periodic chain of bounded rectangular strokes turns inward into a connected meander.

guide.hint: A periodic chain of bounded rectangular strokes turns inward into a connected meander.

document.name: Guilloche angle lace
document.description: True azimuth and counter-winding trigonometric phases form a fine radial lace; a fractional power lifts its crossing filaments.

guide.hint: True azimuth and counter-winding trigonometric phases form a fine radial lace; a fractional power lifts its crossing filaments.

document.name: SDF difference — sharp
document.description: A torus is subtracted from a box distance field; repeated signed contours show sharp corners at the cut junction.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: SDF intersection — sharp
document.description: A sphere distance field clipped by a box forms a lens with sharp contour junctions.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: SDF union — sharp
document.description: Two overlapping sphere distance fields meet at a sharp seam, surrounded by repeated signed contours.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: Thermal colour map
document.description: Fractal noise through the built-in magma colour map gives a thermal-camera-like colour pattern.

document.name: Hierarchical crackle glaze
document.description: Fine cell cracks change phase across larger cells; a heavier coarse boundary encloses the glazed compartments.

guide.hint: Fine cell cracks change phase across larger cells; a heavier coarse boundary encloses the glazed compartments.

document.name: High-resolution chemical maze
document.description: A 128² field-seeded simulation supports a finer chemical labyrinth at modest memory cost; bilinear periodic sampling extrudes the finished result through Z.

guide.hint: A 128² field-seeded simulation supports a finer chemical labyrinth at modest memory cost; bilinear periodic sampling extrudes the finished result through Z.

document.name: Ice
document.description: Pale cloudy blue ice with sparse dark hairline fractures and faint neighbouring fragments.

document.name: Interference rings
document.description: Two offset concentric wave systems create clean interference lobes without noise.

guide.hint: Inspect each offset ring pattern separately; emergent colour lobes come from composition, not physical wave simulation.

document.name: Gas-giant bands
document.description: Unequal cream, ochre and red-brown atmospheric belts with undulating turbulent boundaries and fine cloud streaks.

document.name: Interlocking knitted loops
document.description: Repeated paired oval yarn loops overlap at the stitch necks, retaining open loop interiors.

guide.hint: Repeated paired oval yarn loops overlap at the stitch necks, retaining open loop interiors.

document.name: Lava
document.description: Large cooled dark plates split by thin fissures grading from red edges to yellow-hot centres.

guide.hint: Inspect the hot fissure layers separately from the cooled dark plates.

document.name: Short grass
document.description: Fine upright green fibres over broad dark and dry olive patches suggest close-cut grass.

document.name: Layered gradients
document.description: A transparent-to-blue horizontal gradient layered over a red-to-green vertical one.

guide.hint: Inspect the transparent blue top ramp and the opaque red/green backdrop separately.

document.name: Grid tile inlay
document.description: Shared tile ownership keeps a local radial inlay, seeded colour variation and constant-width grout aligned.

guide.hint: Shared tile ownership keeps a local radial inlay, seeded colour variation and constant-width grout aligned.

document.name: Herringbone aligned grain
document.description: Native domino ownership turns local wood grain with each perpendicular plank, while stable tile values vary its colour.

guide.hint: Native domino ownership turns local wood grain with each perpendicular plank, while stable tile values vary its colour.

document.name: Hexagonal medallions
document.description: Local coordinate projections centre concentric decorations inside regular hexagonal tiles; one shared edge field draws the grout.

guide.hint: Local coordinate projections centre concentric decorations inside regular hexagonal tiles; one shared edge field draws the grout.

document.name: Running bond tile inlay
document.description: Shared running-bond ownership aligns radial inlays and grout; seeded values and stable column identities vary tile colours.

guide.hint: Shared running-bond ownership aligns radial inlays and grout; seeded values and stable column identities vary tile colours.

document.name: Broken leopard rosettes
document.description: Cell-centred dark annuli break into irregular rosettes around muted ochre interiors.

guide.hint: Cell-centred dark annuli break into irregular rosettes around muted ochre interiors.

document.name: Localised flow warp
document.description: Gold bands are disturbed near the centre by a noise-driven vector warp that fades with distance.

guide.hint: Inspect the distance threshold and scalar-scaled displacement vector; reduce warp amount to zero.

document.name: Malachite
document.description: Folded emerald growth bands, compressed into multiple irregular green mineral centres.

guide.hint: Inspect the circular source, then vary the two turbulence amounts independently.

document.name: Marble
document.description: Quiet pale stone crossed by a few broad folded grey veins and a subordinate hairline system.

guide.hint: Inspect the broad and hairline vein layers separately; change their warp amounts to control folding.

document.name: Masked knot study
document.description: A brown ringed insert replaces the centre of gold bands, while an independent mask fades the surrounding grain deflection.

guide.hint: Inspect colour-replacement and displacement masks separately; neither needs ramp alpha to control grain deflection.

document.name: Moiré
document.description: Two clean stripe grids, slightly rotated and detuned, create large emergent interference beats.

guide.hint: Use a larger slice to see fine lines; change stripe detuning or angle to alter the broad emergent beats.

document.name: Mossy stone
document.description: Broad quiet moss colonies with modest fine granular growth, darker interiors, ragged edges and very sparse pale lichen.

document.name: Branching mountain range
document.description: Broad branching ridges and dark drainage valleys with subtle fine detail along the uplands.

document.name: Multi-eye burl grain
document.description: Many cellular growth centres carry warped concentric wood bands with a shared fine grain overlay.

guide.hint: Many cellular growth centres carry warped concentric wood bands with a shared fine grain overlay.

document.name: Nebula
document.description: Broad violet and warm gaseous clouds with dark voids, finer eddies and scattered tiny stars.

document.name: Nested corrosion
document.description: Copper-orange islands sit inside a broader blue-green patina, using two independent scalar masks.

guide.hint: Inspect both scalar masks independently of colour; the smaller copper islands are nested inside broader patina.

document.name: Nested fractal frost
document.description: A ridged fractal sum samples a billowy fractal source, demonstrating a generic noise combinator rather than fixed Perlin octaves.

guide.hint: Inspect the inner billowy fractal before the outer ridged sum; tune their octaves independently.

document.name: Oblique oriented volume
document.description: A depth field rotates sampling around a fixed oblique axis; cutaways expose changing stripe orientation through the volume.

guide.hint: A depth field rotates sampling around a fixed oblique axis; cutaways expose changing stripe orientation through the volume.

document.name: Plane distance bands
document.description: Oblique signed-distance contours repeat on both sides of a plane, colouring the solid in parallel bands.

guide.hint: Inspect signed distance in greyscale; zero is the primitive boundary, negative values are inside, and positive values are outside.

document.name: Ocean
document.description: Directional blue-green water with crossing disturbances and broken pale crests.

document.name: Octagon-and-dot floor
document.description: Regular clipped-square octagons leave smaller contrasting diamond dots between their corners.

guide.hint: Regular clipped-square octagons leave smaller contrasting diamond dots between their corners.

document.name: Offset medallions
document.description: Gold-rimmed round motifs sit off-centre in repeating cells and extend through the solid.

guide.hint: Change the translation and repeat periods. A zero Z scale projects the motif into an extruded XY field.

document.name: Banded onyx
document.description: Broad smooth cream and honey bands with quiet translucent-looking colour depth.

document.name: Zero-jitter cells
document.description: A regular feature grid uses seeded per-cell values for a repeatable muted square-cell palette.

guide.hint: Raise jitter from zero while holding the seed fixed; then change the seed separately.

document.name: Overlapping fish scales
document.description: Staggered rounded scale faces overlap rear crescents; dark rims define the layered rows.

guide.hint: Staggered rounded scale faces overlap rear crescents; dark rims define the layered rows.

document.name: Overlapping scattered discs
document.description: Large bounded discs overlap with stable highest-hash ownership; each disc retains its local concentric colour bands.

guide.hint: Large bounded discs overlap with stable highest-hash ownership; each disc retains its local concentric colour bands.

document.name: Parchment
document.description: Quiet aged cream paper, soft brown stains, faint fibre mottling and subtly darkened edges.

document.name: Peacock eye and barbs
document.description: An elongated concentric eye sits within fine radial barb stripes formed by angular sector folding.

guide.hint: An elongated concentric eye sits within fine radial barb stripes formed by angular sector folding.

document.name: Native periodic Perlin tile
document.description: An eight-cell gradient lattice repeats in a unit cube, with native wrapped corner hashes rather than crossfaded copies.

guide.hint: An eight-cell gradient lattice repeats in a unit cube, with native wrapped corner hashes rather than crossfaded copies.

document.name: Seamless ridged agate
document.description: Unrotated integer-frequency periodic octaves create fine folded agate bands that match across every unit-cube face.

guide.hint: Unrotated integer-frequency periodic octaves create fine folded agate bands that match across every unit-cube face.

document.name: Periodically warped silk
document.description: A period-preserving displacement bends billowy periodic octaves; the displacement and source share the same lattice periods.

guide.hint: A period-preserving displacement bends billowy periodic octaves; the displacement and source share the same lattice periods.

document.name: Perlin field
document.description: A single octave of three-dimensional gradient noise, without fractal summation or distortion.

guide.hint: Inspect Noise directly. Swap Viridis for Cividis or Inferno to compare built-in palettes while preserving this exact field.

document.name: Pine
document.description: Light golden wood with eccentric annual bands, uneven growth spacing and fine longitudinal grain.

document.name: Plaid
document.description: Crossed broad colour bands with fine cream accents; translucent intersections deepen the colours.

document.name: Plain weave crossings
document.description: Alternating warp and weft ownership at each crossing, with coloured thread margins.

guide.hint: Alternating warp and weft ownership at each crossing, with coloured thread margins.

document.name: Rainbow plasma
document.description: Turbulent multiscale noise folds saturated rainbow colours into a swirling field.

document.name: Polar rosette
document.description: Ten repeated soft petals circle a dark centre, formed by folding one off-centre motif into angular sectors.

guide.hint: Inspect the off-centre source motif; vary the sector count to change the rosette symmetry.

document.name: Position RGB
document.description: Signed world coordinates visualised as RGB: each channel maps -1 to 0, zero to 0.5 and 1 to 1; X controls red, Y green and Z blue.

guide.hint: Vector colour uses the signed inspection range [-1,1]. XY at Z=0 has blue 0.5; compare Z=-1 (no blue) with Z=1 (full blue), or inspect the cutaway.

document.name: Prismatic mosaic
document.description: Direct seeded cell RGB colours, with true Voronoi edge-distance gold grouting. Two-dimensional cells are extruded through the cube.

guide.hint: Inspect cell RGB and the independent true-edge grout mask; 2D cells ignore Z.

document.name: Quarter-sawn ray flecks
document.description: Short pale ray flecks cut across continuous axial wood bands rather than following their grain.

guide.hint: Short pale ray flecks cut across continuous axial wood bands rather than following their grain.

document.name: Radial orientation ribbons
document.description: Distance from the pivot controls rotation angle, sweeping straight stripes into a radial ribbon composition.

guide.hint: Distance from the pivot controls rotation angle, sweeping straight stripes into a radial ribbon composition.

document.name: Radially repeated shells
document.description: An off-axis tonal motif repeats across radial shells while retaining its angular variation and depth.

guide.hint: The off-axis source preserves angular variation after radial folding. Compare the domain shell period with the separate wrapped colour ramp; neither makes spheres.

document.name: Angular fan
document.description: A cylindrical angular field runs from red above the centre to green below, with matching colours on either side.

guide.hint: Inspect the angular scalar: left and right have matching values, so it is not a full atan2 azimuth sweep.

document.name: Clamp ramp
document.description: The same planar field runs from -1 to 3 across X; out-of-range values stay at the endpoint colours.

guide.hint: Compare the three modes with the same field and Viridis palette. X=.25 gives 0, X=.5 gives 1, and the full image includes both out-of-range sides.

document.name: Mirror ramp
document.description: The same planar field runs from -1 to 3 across X; alternate integer spans reverse the palette.

guide.hint: Compare the three modes with the same field and Viridis palette. X=.25 gives 0, X=.5 gives 1, and the full image includes both out-of-range sides.

document.name: Wrap ramp
document.description: The same planar field runs from -1 to 3 across X; each integer restarts the palette.

guide.hint: Compare the three modes with the same field and Viridis palette. X=.25 gives 0, X=.5 gives 1, and the full image includes both out-of-range sides.

document.name: Cell-warped colony
document.description: Seeded cell-colour vectors displace a precomputed chemical concentration field into discontinuous Voronoi-shaped fragments.

guide.hint: Inspect the seeded cell-colour vector; turn displacement off to recover the unwarped chemical field.

document.name: Chemical U — same simulation
document.description: The U concentration of the same simulation used by Chemical colony; U and V are distinct chemical fields, not guaranteed exact complements.

guide.hint: This is a coloured U presentation. Use the Raw chemical U/V family for a controlled comparison with the same 0–1 greyscale range; concentration switches reuse the cached volume.

document.name: Chemical colony
document.description: A mature 3D Gray–Scott membrane network grown from seeded patches on a periodic 48³ grid after 550 steps.

guide.hint: Compare Initial chemical noise (0), Developing chemical membranes (100) and this mature 550-step volume. Grid, seed, chemistry and colour mapping are identical. Higher-feed chemical colony changes feed only.

document.name: Fractal fossil
document.description: Rotated multiscale sampling of a cached chemical field forms layered dark membranes and pale pockets without advancing the chemistry.

guide.hint: Inspect the cached concentration before octave sampling; fractal octaves do not advance the chemistry.

document.name: Inlaid chemical colony
document.description: A central spherical mask reveals chemical concentration lobes inside ridged stone, with subtle screen-blended copper highlights.

guide.hint: The central slice exposes the chemical insert. Inspect the spherical mask; colour and blend edits reuse the simulation.

document.name: Early reaction patches
document.description: A seeded concentration field at 40 steps, before this chemistry eventually settles to a uniform state.

guide.hint: Increase iterations from 40 to follow diffusion; this particular configuration eventually settles to a uniform state.

document.name: Chemical strata
document.description: A slab initial state evolves into concentration layers, exposed in XY by an oblique sampling frame.

guide.hint: Inspect the slab before its oblique domain transform; compare different slice orientations.

document.name: Warped membrane
document.description: Perlin vector displacement bends precomputed chemical strata into soft irregular membranes.

guide.hint: Set warp amount to zero to recover chemical strata; the displacement does not rerun the simulation.

document.name: Mirrored red–green ramp
document.description: Linear colour transitions traverse six ramp spans across the image: three complete mirrored red-to-green-to-red cycles.

guide.hint: Compare with sinusoidal easing using identical endpoints and scale; mirror gives three full out-and-back periods.

document.name: Sinusoidal red–green ramp
document.description: Sinusoidally eased transitions traverse six ramp spans across the image: three complete mirrored red-to-green-to-red cycles.

guide.hint: Compare with the linear mirrored ramp; easing changes transitions, not their endpoints or period count.

document.name: Regular honeycomb outlines
document.description: Native regular-hexagon ownership supplies exact shared boundary distance for constant-width honeycomb outlines.

guide.hint: Native regular-hexagon ownership supplies exact shared boundary distance for constant-width honeycomb outlines.

document.name: Spherical rings
document.description: Mirrored point-distance colours form concentric XY rings and spherical bands through the solid.

document.name: Rotate, then translate
document.description: The same offset, angle, repeat period and medallion source; only translation/rotation order differs.

guide.hint: Domain maps apply first, then second to the sample point. Swap the first two maps while preserving every parameter; the lattice shift changes.

document.name: Rust
document.description: Soft nested oxidation blooms over dark metal, with crisp granular corrosion, dark pits and tiny ochre highlights.

document.name: Salami cross-section
document.description: Variable pale fat inclusions and smaller flecks interrupt a mottled red matrix; the inclusions extend through the volume.

guide.hint: Variable pale fat inclusions and smaller flecks interrupt a mottled red matrix; the inclusions extend through the volume.

document.name: Sand ripples
document.description: Fine wind ripples with consistent light and shadow, gently varying spacing and independent sand grain.

document.name: Sandstone strata
document.description: Fine undulating warm strata with mineral grain and subtle within-band variation.

document.name: Scalar maximum
document.description: Pointwise higher of two equal-scale Perlin fields with a fixed offset between them.

guide.hint: Inspect A and B. Minimum selects the darker sample; maximum selects the lighter. These are unsigned noise fields, not SDF joins.

document.name: Scalar minimum
document.description: Pointwise lower of two equal-scale Perlin fields with a fixed offset between them.

guide.hint: Inspect A and B. Minimum selects the darker sample; maximum selects the lighter. These are unsigned noise fields, not SDF joins.

document.name: Scalar mixing with alpha
document.description: A planar mask interpolates translucent blue and red; both inputs and every mixed result retain half opacity.

guide.hint: The mask selects blue toward X=1. Inspect alpha: mixing equal input alpha keeps it constant. Scalar mixing interpolates straight RGB; colour-ramp interpolation uses premultiplied OKLab.

document.name: Scattered leaf fall
document.description: A broad site-density mask places independently rotated, scaled leaf motifs; local veins travel with each mark.

guide.hint: A broad site-density mask places independently rotated, scaled leaf motifs; local veins travel with each mark.

document.name: Scattered volume inclusions
document.description: Sparse variable-radius bounded marks occupy a three-dimensional dark matrix; cutaways reveal independently placed interiors.

guide.hint: Sparse variable-radius bounded marks occupy a three-dimensional dark matrix; cutaways reveal independently placed interiors.

document.name: Screened contours
document.description: Screen-blended torus bands form a central inlay in a blue and gold ridged mineral field.

guide.hint: Use the central XZ slice to see torus bands; inspect Source, Backdrop and the spherical mask separately.

document.name: Broken sea-foam loops
document.description: Unequal cell-centred white loops break apart over quiet blue-green water, with sparse fine froth.

guide.hint: Unequal cell-centred white loops break apart over quiet blue-green water, with sparse fine froth.

document.name: Seamless stone tile
document.description: Four shifted noise fields crossfade across X and Y before a unit repeat, matching both values and boundary slopes for a continuous stone tile.

guide.hint: Inspect opposite sides of X=.5 and Y=.5. Smooth crossfades match the boundary samples before repetition; applying Repeat directly to ordinary noise would leave seams.

document.name: Second-neighbour cells
document.description: Worley F2 traces distance to the second-nearest feature; low jitter retains a regular petal-like pattern.

document.name: Muted cell mosaic
document.description: A random ramp value per Euclidean Voronoi cell, with thin true-distance grouting around the boundary.

guide.hint: Change the seed to recolour/rearrange cells; inspect edge distance to tune grout width independently.

document.name: Shared accent ramp
document.description: Two differently placed circular fields use one document-local accent ramp; editing its stops updates both together.

guide.hint: Edit the document ramp named accent rather than either reference. Both badges use the same stops.

document.name: Smiley
document.description: A clean yellow smiley face with shared shaded eyes and a clipped lower smile arc over a blue noise background.

guide.hint: The two eyes share one named ramp; editing that ramp changes both eyes together.

document.name: Smoke
document.description: Drifting vertically stretched smoke plumes with turbulent edges, internal holes and fading tops.

document.name: SDF difference — smooth
document.description: A torus is subtracted from a box distance field; smoothing rounds the cut junctions in the repeated signed contours.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: SDF intersection — smooth
document.description: A sphere distance field clipped by a box forms a lens with softened contour junctions.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: SDF union — smooth
document.description: Rounded distance bands bridge two overlapping sphere fields, softening their shared seam.

guide.hint: Compare the paired sharp/smooth field with identical inputs; set smoothing to zero for a hard join. These contours colour the existing geometry.

document.name: Source-linked short stains
document.description: Six shifted, fading copies of sparse source marks create bounded downward stain trails tied to the original deposits.

guide.hint: Six shifted, fading copies of sparse source marks create bounded downward stain trails tied to the original deposits.

document.name: Source-over with alpha
document.description: A blue foreground fades from transparent to half opacity over a half-opaque red backdrop; coverage grows toward the blue side.

guide.hint: At X=1 the blue layer is half opaque over half-opaque red: total alpha is about 0.75. Scalar mixing keeps alpha near 0.5.

document.name: Spatial chemical atlas
document.description: Independent feed and kill fields vary across a 2D periodic solver, producing different spot and membrane regimes from one scalar-seeded patch field.

guide.hint: Independent feed and kill fields vary across a 2D periodic solver, producing different spot and membrane regimes from one scalar-seeded patch field.

document.name: Sphere distance bands
document.description: Signed-distance contours form spherical bands inside and outside a sphere.

guide.hint: Inspect signed distance in greyscale; zero is the primitive boundary, negative values are inside, and positive values are outside.

document.name: Staggered brickwork
document.description: Eight courses of offset rectangular bricks with recessed-looking mortar borders and muted clay variation; colour fields suggest the surface without adding geometry.

guide.hint: Checker row parity alternates the half-brick offset. A signed box mask separates clay from mortar; the preview solid remains unchanged.

document.name: Stepped spiral inlay
document.description: Floor selects discrete spiral bands while fractional phase supplies fine repeating accents within each band.

guide.hint: Floor selects discrete spiral bands while fractional phase supplies fine repeating accents within each band.

document.name: Storm front
document.description: Laterally flowing dark storm masses with lighter torn upper wisps and quiet gaps.

document.name: Stretched medallions
document.description: Anisotropic scaling stretches gold-rimmed medallions into tall oval motifs, extruded through the solid.

guide.hint: Change X and Y scale independently; keep Z projection to retain the extruded motif.

document.name: Hard-stop stripes
document.description: Repeating red/pink and white/grey gradients meet at abrupt boundaries formed by duplicated midpoint stops and ramp wrapping.

guide.hint: Inspect the duplicated stops at 0.5; separate hard stops from the gradients within each stripe.

document.name: Sunset clouds
document.description: Dark cloud bands over orange-pink dusk with a cooler purple upper sky.

document.name: Sunset
document.description: A clean dusk gradient with softened sea horizon, broad solar halo and faint elongated cloud streaks.

document.name: Brass angular fan
document.description: A symmetric angular field combines with distance bands to form a brass-toned fan with a pinched centre.

guide.hint: Inspect angular and distance contributions separately, then vary the distance multiplier.

document.name: Doubly warped stripes
document.description: Two nested turbulence fields unevenly displace broad navy and white bands while preserving their underlying direction.

document.name: Terrain
document.description: Coherent landmasses, medium hills and fine highlands with restrained colours and snow only at the highest elevations.

guide.hint: This is an elevation-colour field, not displaced geometry. Compare the two contour-map styles on related terrain sources.

document.name: Hard threshold
document.description: The same Perlin field is turned into a binary mask by equal threshold bounds.

guide.hint: Equal bounds give a hard step. A finite interval gives smoothstep; neither changes the sampled noise.

document.name: Smooth threshold
document.description: The same Perlin field is turned into a smooth mask across the interval 0.4–0.6.

guide.hint: Equal bounds give a hard step. A finite interval gives smoothstep; neither changes the sampled noise.

document.name: Tiger’s eye
document.description: Directional amber mineral fibres and fixed gold highlight bands evoke tiger’s-eye stone.

document.name: Tiger markings
document.description: Irregular near-black tapered markings on warm orange fibres suggest a stylised tiger coat.

document.name: Tile boundary pigment wear
document.description: Pigment loss follows the generated mortar grid; noise varies how far the worn margins penetrate each tile.

guide.hint: Pigment loss follows the generated mortar grid; noise varies how far the worn margins penetrate each tile.

document.name: Topographic map
document.description: Muted elevation colours with minor contours and a stronger line every fourth elevation interval.

guide.hint: Inspect minor and major contour layers independently; enlarge the slice to see the fine line hierarchy.

document.name: Torus distance bands
document.description: Copper and teal signed-distance contours extend inside and outside a torus.

guide.hint: Inspect signed distance in greyscale; zero is the primitive boundary, negative values are inside, and positive values are outside.

document.name: Translate, then rotate
document.description: The same offset, angle, repeat period and medallion source; only translation/rotation order differs.

guide.hint: Domain maps apply first, then second to the sample point. Swap the first two maps while preserving every parameter; the lattice shift changes.

document.name: Translucent overprint
document.description: Partly transparent overlay combines two discontinuous ramps. Download a slice PNG to retain the composited alpha.

guide.hint: Inspect Source and Backdrop separately; export a slice PNG to retain final composited alpha.

document.name: Stratified travertine
document.description: Fine horizontal strata are interrupted by elongated cellular pores at two independent scales.

guide.hint: Fine horizontal strata are interrupted by elongated cellular pores at two independent scales.

document.name: Connected Truchet paths
document.description: Seeded tile choices join matching quarter-circle exits into continuous paths.

guide.hint: Seeded tile choices join matching quarter-circle exits into continuous paths.

document.name: Turtle scute growth lines
document.description: Matching cellular interiors and true boundaries couple fine concentric growth lines to larger scute divisions.

guide.hint: Matching cellular interiors and true boundaries couple fine concentric growth lines to larger scute divisions.

document.name: Twisted ribbons
document.description: Height-dependent twist winds gold and navy ribbons around a solid; different Z slices reveal their rotation.

guide.hint: Compare XY slices at Z=0 and Z=0.5; twist rotates the sampling frame by an amount proportional to depth.

document.name: Twisted torus bands
document.description: Height-dependent twist winds repeated torus distance contours through the solid without changing the preview geometry.

guide.hint: Compare XY slices at different depths; twist changes torus sampling, not the preview object's geometry.

document.name: Variable-radius halftone
document.description: A broad left-to-right field controls disc radii outside the local repeat, changing dot coverage continuously.

guide.hint: A broad left-to-right field controls disc radii outside the local repeat, changing dot coverage continuously.

document.name: Vector colour clouds
document.description: Three decorrelated scalar channels form soft RGB colour clouds, making the vector components inspectable.

document.name: Verdigris
document.description: Exposed copper, brown transitional oxidation and clustered turquoise-green patina interleaved at several scales.

guide.hint: Inspect copper, transitional oxidation and patina layers separately.

document.name: Volcanic cells
document.description: Three-dimensional Worley gap gives a glowing fracture network through the whole solid. Slice it to see the changing cells.

document.name: Volumetric cell mosaic
document.description: Three-dimensional seeded cell colours form angular fragments that change along every axis, unlike extruded 2D cells.

guide.hint: Move XY through Z or change slice axis to see genuinely three-dimensional cell fragments.

document.name: Walnut
document.description: Rich dark wood with broad sweeping figure, strongly bent grain and finer embedded dark lines.

guide.hint: Reduce the turbulence amount to separate broad figure from finer grain.

document.name: Warped mineral turbulence
document.description: An absolute-fractal sum of domain-warped noise builds warm fractured mineral mottling.

guide.hint: Inspect the warped noise source before the absolute-fractal sum; generic turbulence can sample any scalar source.

document.name: Pond ripples
document.description: Three unequal ripple sources send curved pale crests across quiet blue-grey water, with gently broken highlights and finer surface variation.

document.name: Watercolour wash
document.description: Soft blue, rose and ochre colour washes overlap on quiet warm paper with faint pigment mottling.

document.name: Weathered relic
document.description: Fractal Perlin detail roughens box distance contours; a smooth mask reveals veined stone underneath.

document.name: Wobbly stripes
document.description: Mostly parallel stripes displaced by broad low-frequency side-to-side wobble.

document.name: Wood knot
document.description: Eccentric dark branch grain with merged growth bands, an irregular oval boundary and unequal compression of the surrounding trunk grain.

guide.hint: Compare with Masked knot study to distinguish a finished wood composition from explicit displacement masking.

document.name: Chebyshev cells — square contours
document.description: Worley F1 with maximum-axis distance forms square contours around the nearest feature points.

guide.hint: Change Metric while holding feature sites, scale, seed and palette fixed; compare Euclidean, Manhattan and Chebyshev contours.

document.name: Euclidean cells — pebbled jade
document.description: Worley F1 with Euclidean distance forms rounded contours around the nearest feature points.

guide.hint: Change Metric while holding feature sites, scale, seed and palette fixed; compare Euclidean, Manhattan and Chebyshev contours.

document.name: Nearest neighbour F1
document.description: Matched Euclidean sites, 2D cells, seed 42, full jitter, scale and a fixed 0–1.5 greyscale range; only the neighbour output changes.

guide.hint: Compare F1, F2 and F2−F1 without changing sites or normalising each image separately. All three use a fixed 0–1.5 range.

document.name: Second neighbour F2
document.description: Matched Euclidean sites, 2D cells, seed 42, full jitter, scale and a fixed 0–1.5 greyscale range; only the neighbour output changes.

guide.hint: Compare F1, F2 and F2−F1 without changing sites or normalising each image separately. All three use a fixed 0–1.5 range.

document.name: Neighbour gap F2−F1
document.description: Matched Euclidean sites, 2D cells, seed 42, full jitter, scale and a fixed 0–1.5 greyscale range; only the neighbour output changes.

guide.hint: Compare F1, F2 and F2−F1 without changing sites or normalising each image separately. All three use a fixed 0–1.5 range.

document.name: Manhattan cells — diamond paving
document.description: Worley F1 with summed-axis distance forms diamond contours around the nearest feature points.

guide.hint: Change Metric while holding feature sites, scale, seed and palette fixed; compare Euclidean, Manhattan and Chebyshev contours.

document.name: Zebra stripes
document.description: Crisp black and ivory stripes bend, compress and split under two scales of deformation.

domain.description: Inverse fixed-axis rotation about a pivot. Angle is a scalar field in degrees, sampled at the incoming point; zero axis is identity.
domain.label: Field rotation

domain.description: Sample a motif in centred owned tile coordinates. Z passes through.
domain.label: Layout local domain

domain.description: Inverse Euler rotation: undo Z, Y, then X. Angles are degrees.
domain.label: Rotate

domain.description: Divide coordinates by scale; zero collapses that axis.
domain.label: Scale

domain.description: Centred modulo cells; nonpositive periods disable an axis.
domain.label: Repeat cells

domain.description: Fold axes whose selection is at least 0.5 around the centre.
domain.label: Mirror

domain.description: Fold XY into angular sectors around the centre, preserving Z.
domain.label: Polar repeat

domain.description: Wrap XY radius into rings, preserving angle and Z.
domain.label: Radial repeat

domain.description: Rotate XY about Z by height. Amount is degrees per unit.
domain.label: Twist

domain.description: Rotate XY by horizontal position. Amount is degrees per unit.
domain.label: Bend

domain.description: Apply First to coordinates, then Second. Order matters.
domain.label: Compose domains

domain.description: Add Amount times an arbitrary vector field to coordinates.
domain.label: Vector warp

scalar.description: A scalar value everywhere.
scalar.label: Constant

scalar.description: Worker-prepared Gray–Scott concentration with scalar seeding/feed/kill. 2D uses a four-neighbour periodic stencil and extrudes through Z; 3D uses six neighbours.
scalar.label: Field-driven reaction

scalar.description: Precomputed 3D Gray–Scott concentrations, sampled periodically with trilinear interpolation. Chemistry edits resimulate; colour and domain edits reuse the volume.
scalar.label: Reaction–diffusion

scalar.description: Distances to the first/second seeded feature point. Gap is F2 minus F1, not edge distance.
scalar.label: Worley noise

scalar.description: A seeded value in [0,1) for each Euclidean Voronoi cell.
scalar.label: Cell random value

scalar.description: Distance-like signed envelope of a prepared finite binary branching network. Tapered tubes are approximate, not exact SDFs.
scalar.label: Branching distance

scalar.description: Unsigned distance to the owned XY tile boundary in lattice units.
scalar.label: Layout edge distance

scalar.description: Stable seeded value per owned tile.
scalar.label: Layout random value

scalar.description: True Euclidean distance to the closest cell bisector; zero on cell boundaries.
scalar.label: Voronoi edge distance

scalar.description: Signed distance: negative inside, zero on the surface.
scalar.label: Sphere SDF

scalar.description: Exact signed distance to an axis-aligned box.
scalar.label: Box SDF

scalar.description: Capped cylinder along Y; rotate its domain to change axis.
scalar.label: Cylinder SDF

scalar.description: Ring around Y, with major and tube radii.
scalar.label: Torus SDF

scalar.description: Signed distance along a normal (normalised automatically).
scalar.label: Plane SDF

scalar.description: Combine distance fields. Amount zero is hard; positive amount rounds the join.
scalar.label: SDF union

scalar.description: Combine distance fields. Amount zero is hard; positive amount rounds the join.
scalar.label: SDF intersection

scalar.description: Combine distance fields. Amount zero is hard; positive amount rounds the join.
scalar.label: SDF difference

scalar.description: Projected distance from the start to the end.
scalar.label: Planar distance

scalar.description: Distance from the centre divided by radius.
scalar.label: Point distance

scalar.description: Mirrored sweep around an axis.
scalar.label: Cylindrical angle

scalar.description: Native integer lattice periods on all axes.
scalar.label: Periodic Perlin

scalar.description: Unrotated, integer-frequency octaves preserve the requested period; normalised weighted sum.
scalar.label: Periodic fractal

scalar.description: Uncoloured Perlin noise; transform its coordinates to change frequency.
scalar.label: Perlin source

scalar.description: Rotated, offset octaves of any scalar noise source, with artistic contrast.
scalar.label: Fractal sum

scalar.description: Absolute centred octaves of any scalar source.
scalar.label: Turbulence sum

scalar.label: Minimum

scalar.label: Maximum

scalar.description: Map one interval to another, without clamping.

scalar.description: Sine in radians.
scalar.label: Sine

scalar.description: Cosine in radians.

scalar.description: Absolute value.
scalar.label: Absolute value

scalar.description: Round toward negative infinity.
scalar.label: Floor

scalar.description: Value minus floor, including negative coordinates.

scalar.description: Division; denominators within 1e-8 of zero return zero.
scalar.label: Safe divide

scalar.description: Invalid real powers and non-finite FP32 results return zero.
scalar.label: Power

scalar.description: Unclamped scalar interpolation; amounts outside 0–1 extrapolate.
scalar.label: Scalar interpolation

scalar.description: Clamp to sorted bounds.
scalar.label: Scalar clamp

scalar.description: True XY atan2 angle in turns [0,1), zero on positive X and at the centre.

scalar.description: Read one component of a vector field.
scalar.label: Vector component

scalar.description: A smooth mask between two thresholds; equal thresholds make a hard step.
scalar.label: Smooth threshold

vector.description: Six central scalar samples; derivatives are per current coordinate unit. Step trades detail for numerical stability.
vector.label: Scalar gradient

vector.description: Six central vector samples; useful for RGB texture displacement. Units are vector units per coordinate unit.

vector.description: Unit direction, with zero preserved and finite component guards. Scale first to avoid norm overflow.
vector.label: Normalise vector

vector.description: Integer lattice coordinates of the nearest Euclidean feature point. Stable identity, not a scalar noise value.

vector.description: Seeded RGB per Euclidean cell, represented as a vector in [-1,1] for Vector colour.

vector.description: Integer tile anchor/axial identity, with Z zero.

vector.description: Centred tile coordinates; herringbone aligns the long axis with Y. Z passes through.

vector.description: Attenuate a displacement by a scalar mask.
